createAccount.question: How do I create an account?
createAccount.answer: Sign up for an account by clicking the 'Sign Up' button on our homepage. You can register using your email address and create a password.

createProject.question: How do I create my first project?
createProject.answer: After logging in, navigate to the dashboard and click the 'New Project' button. Fill in the project details and click 'Create'.

changePassword.question: How can I change my password?
changePassword.answer: Go to your Account Settings, navigate to the Security tab, and click on 'Change Password'. You'll need to enter your current password and then your new password.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: To delete your account, go to Account Settings, scroll to the bottom, and click on 'Delete Account'. Please note that this action is irreversible.

projectSettings.question: Where can I find project settings?
projectSettings.answer: Project settings can be accessed by selecting your project from the dashboard, then clicking on the 'Settings' tab in the project navigation.

collectFeedback.question: How do I start collecting feedback?
collectFeedback.answer: After creating a project, you'll receive a unique link that you can share with your users. You can also embed the feedback widget on your website using our integration code.

exportData.question: Can I export my feedback data?
exportData.answer: Yes, you can export your feedback data in CSV or JSON format. Go to your project, navigate to the 'Export' tab, select your preferred format, and click 'Export Data'.
